frame.gridTemplateAreas: "tp tp tp" "br ct dk" "ch ch dk" "sb sb sb"

controls.label: Browser
controls.function: Show or hide the browser (⌘⌥B).

controls.label: Tap · ping
controls.function: Asks every running agent for a status line now instead of at the next heartbeat. Answers land in the Agents tile.

controls.label: Effort
controls.function: Where Live has tempo: how hard the armed session thinks per turn (low → max). Each task can override it.

controls.label: Effort −
controls.function: One step less effort.

controls.label: Effort +
controls.function: One step more effort.

controls.label: Heartbeat
controls.function: Where Live has the metronome: running agents check in on a cadence. Each check-in moves that thread’s needle in the Arrangement; a needle that stops is a stall.

controls.label: Tokens
controls.function: Where Live has key and scale: a token counter. Click to switch what it counts — selected session · group · everything open.

controls.label: Follow
controls.function: The Arrangement scrolls with the live needles and Context tiles follow what the selected agent touches. Off: nothing moves your view.

controls.label: Run
controls.function: Live’s Play. Launches the selected task, or every queued one. Enter in a composer is the same press.

controls.label: Stop all
controls.function: Once: every running agent pauses at the next quantize point and keeps context. Twice: turns are cancelled and unlanded writes return to basis. Per-session hard stop sits on each track.

controls.label: Voice
controls.function: Live’s Record. Records speech into a new task clip on the armed track, or into the open thread’s composer.

controls.label: Steer · overdub
controls.function: On: what you send while an agent runs steers the running turn. Off: it queues as the next task.

controls.label: Write arm
controls.function: Live’s automation arm. Off: writes arrive as proposals. On: writes inside each world device land directly, with a receipt.

controls.label: Loop
controls.function: The selected task repeats until its stop condition or cap — a routine.

controls.label: Session · Tab
controls.function: Tracks are sessions, clips are tasks.

controls.label: Arrangement · Tab
controls.function: The run viewer: sessions over time, one live needle per thread.

controls.label: Detail
controls.function: Show or hide the device/clip detail (⌘⌥L).

controls.label: Context dock
controls.function: Show or hide the context dock: tiles above, launcher below.

controls.label: Resize
controls.function: Drag left to give the context more room; tiles reflow into columns.

controls.label: Wider
controls.function: Grow the dock leftwards for richer compositions; Session/Arrangement give up width.

controls.label: Narrower
controls.function: Shrink the dock back.

controls.label: Fold
controls.function: Fold the launcher to its search bar; tiles take the height.

controls.label: Library
controls.function: The full context library is also in the browser under Context, where SDK widgets appear too.

controls.label: Runs
controls.function: See this thread among its siblings over time.

controls.label: Fold
controls.function: Tools only.

controls.label: Hand back
controls.function: Live’s re-enable automation. Lit: you edited something an agent holds (HeroShot physics, Honey). Press to hand it back.

controls.label: Capture
controls.function: Live’s session record. Records what you do by hand into a new clip on the armed track — a worked example an agent can learn as a skill.

controls.label: Write window · in
controls.function: Punch-in: no writes before this step (here: until the plan is approved).

controls.label: Punch in
controls.function: Turns the write window’s start on or off.

controls.label: Punch out

controls.label: Write window · out
controls.function: Punch-out step, or the loop cap when Loop is on.

controls.label: Point
controls.function: Live’s draw mode. Mark the stage or any tile; the armed agent receives the mark as a reference.

controls.label: Keys
controls.function: Live’s computer keyboard: number keys launch task rows, letters fire rack macros, Space runs.

controls.label: Earth view (planned)
controls.function: The Earth / Solar-System projection of the World. The button holds its place; the projection is still to be built.

controls.label: Map
controls.function: Live’s MIDI map. Bind a key, pad or spoken phrase to any control — ‘Fizz, retry’.

controls.label: Throughput
controls.function: Where Live shows sample rate: tokens per second across running agents.

controls.label: Context
controls.function: Where Live shows CPU load: the selected session’s context-window fill.

controls.label: Spend

controls.label: ${label}
controls.function: ${info}

controls.label: ${c.name}
controls.function: ${c.desc} Click to open it as a tile in the dock.

controls.label: Curate
controls.function: Save a composition of tiles as a context preset; SDK widgets install here.

controls.label: ${A[k].name}
controls.function: Drag onto a track to seat it as that session’s agent.

controls.label: Skillset · ${n}
controls.function: A rack of skills; drop it on a session’s chain.

controls.label: Git device
controls.function: Drop on a chain: the session commits through it.

controls.label: ${t.name}
controls.function: Open its thread in the main space.

controls.label: Group slot
controls.function: The children’s tasks in this row; launching fires them all. Amber = stalled.

controls.label: ${c.plain?'Clip
controls.function: An ordinary Scene state; agents and native material share the grid.':'Task · '+c.n+'

controls.label: Empty slot
controls.function: Its square stops the session after the current task (soft stop). Double-click to write a task; arm and press ● to speak one.

controls.label: Hard stop
controls.function: Stops ${t.group?'the group and every session in it':'this session'} now — mid-tool if needed — and keeps what was written as a draft.

controls.label: Retry
controls.function: Restarts a stalled or failed task from its last good step, same basis.${lit?' Lit: a lane in here has stalled.':''}

controls.label: Main
controls.function: The whole work: Ledger and Approvals live on its chain.

controls.label: Row · ${r}
controls.function: Launch the row: fires every task in it across sessions — a batch.

controls.label: Main telemetry
controls.function: Everything into the dock and the ledger stream.

controls.label: Subagent model
controls.function: Default model for everything this group spawns; a member’s strip can override it.

controls.label: Telemetry
controls.function: Live’s track activator, on the number: the whole group as a context source. Off: it keeps running but stops feeding the dock, the ledger stream and other agents’ context.

controls.label: Model
controls.function: This session’s model. Subagents can run a different one.

controls.label: Watch
controls.function: Live’s monitor. In: always stream this session into the dock. Auto: when armed or selected. Off: never.

controls.label: Telemetry · context source
controls.function: Live’s track activator. On: this session feeds the dock, the ledger stream and other agents’ context. Off: it keeps working, silently.

controls.label: Solo
controls.function: Only soloed sessions may run.

controls.label: Arm
controls.function: Who you are talking to: voice and the composer send here.

controls.label: Activity · budget
controls.function: Meter: live activity (empty when telemetry is off). Fader: this session’s share of the budget, in turns.

controls.label: Task · ${n}
controls.function: ${st==='run'?'Running — no end is drawn; its needle is the live edge.':st==='stall'?'Stalled: the needle stopped where its output stopped.':'Done.'} Double-click to open the thread.

controls.label: Queued
controls.function: Waiting behind the running task. No length is drawn: nobody knows how long it will take.

controls.label: ${ln} · ${n}
controls.function: An event inside the task. Click: open it in a ${ln} tile.

controls.label: Group
controls.function: Fold or unfold the crew.

controls.label: Runs
controls.function: See this thread among its siblings over time.

controls.label: ${a.name} · agent
controls.function: Compact. Click: expand in the pool. ↗: open its thread full.

controls.label: Power
controls.function: The agent on, or benched.

controls.label: Input
controls.function: Steer the running turn, or queue.

controls.label: Skillset rack · Porting
controls.function: Skills as chains (light = admitted); macros steer several at once.

controls.label: ${n} (folded)
controls.function: A device folded to its title, as in Live.

controls.label: World · bridge-2
controls.function: What the session may read (teal) and write (amber).

controls.label: Write mode
controls.function: propose · draft · direct (direct needs Write arm).

controls.label: Gateway (folded)
controls.function: This session rides its lead’s Hermes gateway connection.

controls.label: Gateway · hermes
controls.function: Where the session runs: the harness connection (Hermes tui_gateway, JSON-RPC over stdio or WebSocket). Frames flow along the link; the ring is the replay buffer; the outer pulse is the heartbeat.

controls.label: Connect
controls.function: Attach or detach this session’s transport. Detached sessions keep running in the harness and are re-attached with session.resume.

controls.label: Transport
controls.function: stdio (spawned child, trusted) · ws (token / 30 s ticket at the upgrade) · remote (through Workcell’s address book).

controls.label: Approvals
controls.function: Default answer to approval.request: ask you each time · allow for this session · always. Deny is always yours to give.

controls.label: Gateways
controls.function: Every gateway this work can reach, as chains. Three are named alike: Hermes’ tui_gateway, AIKit’s agency gateway and Actuation’s gateway on frank. Each row states its standing, never assumed.

controls.label: Frame monitor
controls.function: Live’s MIDI monitor for agents: every frame the gateway sends or receives, per session, in order. Use it to see exactly what a stalled lane last did.

controls.label: Git
controls.function: The session’s repository seat. The diagram is the branch against main; the pulsing hollow dot is uncommitted work.

controls.label: Commit
controls.function: When the agent commits: per turn · per task · manual.

controls.label: Push
controls.function: off · on land.

controls.label: Land
controls.function: Open a draft PR from this branch (checks 2/3 ✓).

controls.label: Agentset · Port crew
controls.function: One chain per member, nested as spawned, each with its model. Click a member to open its thread.

controls.label: Drop zone
controls.function: Gateways, agents, skillsets, worlds, git. Left to right: through → who → how → where → lands.

controls.label: Then
controls.function: Live’s follow action, as hand-off.

controls.label: Output style
controls.function: Per-task override of how the agent writes: register and form.

controls.label: Steers
controls.function: Highlight where steering was heard.

controls.label: Open thread
controls.function: Open this session’s thread in the main space.

controls.label: Pin
controls.function: Stop following; keep this view.

controls.label: Close
controls.function: Close the tile; it stays in the launcher.
